_note: SparK SSL stage only. All sections are merged into one flat settings object. Origin of every value: README.md, section 'SSL recipe'.

setup._export_note: also export the backbone every 5 epochs, for the accuracy-versus-epoch analysis only; the backbone used for A3 is the final epoch, fixed in advance

spark._recon_note: 1 = reconstruct the single SAR channel (A3 change); 3 = the authors' literal target, which here would include the per-channel ImageNet offsets (SPARK_CHANGES.md)

optim._lr_note: peak lr = base_lr x batch_size / 256 = 5e-5 at batch 64 (the authors' rule, arg_util.py L132; paper Section 4.1)
optim._warmup_note: the authors' 40 of 1,600 epochs = the first 2.5% of training; here 2.5 of 100 epochs
optim._batch_note: 64 = same images per step as A1 DINO and A2 LeJEPA (Nischal, 2026-10-18)
optim._epochs_note: same number of epochs as A1 and A2 (Nischal's decision); the authors pre-train for 1,600
